content: This would be an AMAZING win-win for the US: we would stop wasting our resources on that wretched region AND our biggest geopolitical adversaries would start wasting theirs!!! There really is no such thing as freedom for the weak in international politics. If the US were to disengage from the Middle East then Russia and China would move in. Nature abhors a vacuum
In Gary in particular. Buy land in this basin.

Ethan's first book was about AI as chatbots, this one is all about agents. I was lucky enough to get an early copy. If you're interested in agentic AI, get this book. Ethan talks to all the labs, is a critical early tester of the models, and was super early on agentic AI. Hes also an incredible writer, this book was a pleasure to read and learn from. My new book, Co-Existence, is out today. It is a guide to how to live & work in a world where AI is sometimes, but not always, better than you. (And, for the release, I worked with Opus 5.5 to make a quite interesting experience for the book's website: https://co-existence.ai/)
